ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; record this driver cancellation as an unsubstantiated no-show claim + flag_account

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's written claim of waiting 'at least 5 minutes' at the pickup is contradicted by system records: he cancelled only 4 min 55 s after accepting (F4), was within 200 m for a cumulative 2 min 50 s before cancelling (F2, F5) and stayed within 200 m for only 1 min 45 s after tapping 'I'm Here' (F6). System records (gps/timeline) override the driver statement; NS-1(iii)'s > 3-minute requirement is not met, so no valid no-show cancellation arose.
